summary: This Form 8-K filed by Partners Group Lending Fund, LLC reports an unregistered sale of Class M and Class I units under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D to accredited investors, raising approximately $42.995 million. The filing also discloses the fund's NAV per unit as of March 31, 2026 ($1.4964 for both classes) and updates portfolio statistics, including total portfolio size of $483.3 million across 56 borrowers. There is no merger, acquisition, tender offer, shareholder vote, or strategic transaction described. These are routine capital raising and periodic reporting activities, not a special situation.
